name: workbench
description: A complete process system for how work starts, gets designed, gets verified, and lands: audits scoped from the request, brainstorming that resolves design and route choices (direct / plan / goal handoff), implementation discipline (TDD, systematic debugging, evidence-gated readiness), adversarial review at readiness, and landing that files the PR and tends CI to green. Backed by five read-only review agents. Core process skills derived from obra/superpowers (MIT): no hooks, no dispatcher; skills fire on relevance. Adds epic-orchestration for multi-ticket epics whose lanes other sessions implement and the operator dispatches by hand.
